macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Nvidia shares plunge after Jensen Huang resignation
items.summary: Nvidia shares fell sharply after CEO Jensen Huang resigned, with Colette Kress named interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent replacement. The move pressured Nasdaq futures and broader technology stocks.[1][2]

items.title: US stocks mixed as technology shares weaken
items.summary: US trading opened mixed, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.11%, the S&P 500 down 0.77%, and the Nasdaq down 1.51% amid Nvidia-related selling pressure.[1]

items.title: Fed officials signal continued restrictive policy
items.summary: Federal Reserve official Beth Hammack said restrictive monetary policy remains necessary to bring inflation down and warned that recent data is moving in the wrong direction. Markets reportedly priced a 100% probability of a December rate increase, mostly for a 25-basis-point hike.[1]

items.title: CoreWeave results ease concerns about AI infrastructure demand
items.summary: CoreWeave delivered stronger-than-expected results and raised its outlook, helping reassure investors that demand for AI computing infrastructure remains robust. Cisco and Applied Materials were scheduled to report after the market close.[2]

items.title: US weekly jobless claims remain historically low
items.summary: Initial jobless claims edged up to 200,000, a level that remained historically low and consistent with continued labor-market resilience.[2]

items.title: Global bonds remain under pressure as yields rise
items.summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield climbed above 5%, while borrowing costs in Japan and major European economies reached multi-year or multi-decade highs. Equities remained relatively resilient despite concerns about inflation, oil prices, geopolitical risks, and elevated AI valuations.[4]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin weakens as 47,300 BTC flow into exchanges
items.summary: Bitcoin remained under pressure after approximately 47,300 BTC flowed into exchanges at a loss over the past 24 hours, while profitable inflows totaled roughly 1,100 BTC. The data suggests heightened selling pressure and investor capitulation risk.

items.title: Ethereum falls below $2,000 before recovering
items.summary: Ethereum briefly dropped to $1,996.52 on November 12, its first move below $2,000 since August 19, before recovering to around $2,016, still down approximately 3.2% over 24 hours.

items.title: SoFi launches bank-issued stablecoin on Polygon
items.summary: SoFiUSD, described as the first stablecoin issued by a U.S. national bank, went live on Polygon’s Open Money Stack. The deployment expands the stablecoin to its third blockchain after Ethereum and Solana.

items.title: Thailand proposes daily limits for stablecoin transfers
items.summary: Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission proposed daily deposit and withdrawal limits of 5 million baht, approximately $148,000, per customer for regulated crypto operators handling stablecoin transactions.

items.title: Securitize and Ethena launch $100 million BUIDL liquidity tool
items.summary: Securitize and Ethena Labs launched a 24/7 liquidity facility for BlackRock’s tokenized BUIDL fund. Eligible investors can redeem BUIDL shares for supported stablecoins, including USDC, outside traditional market hours.

items.title: DogeOS prepares DeFi and application-layer launch
items.summary: DogeOS said it is close to launching DeFi features and an application layer for the Dogecoin ecosystem. The platform is expected to offer games, applications, and financial services for DOGE holders.

items.title: Pyth Network adds New York Stock Exchange data
items.summary: Pyth Network added real-time stock and exchange-traded fund data from the New York Stock Exchange to its blockchain oracle data marketplace, expanding its coverage of traditional financial markets.

items.title: Stablecoin supply contracts sharply
items.summary: Stablecoin supply reportedly fell by $14.2 billion over the past 30 days, with USDT and USDC outflows nearing $11 billion. The contraction brought total stablecoin supply below $280 billion and reduced market liquidity.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: More than half of laid-off game workers remain unemployed, GDC report finds
items.summary: A new GDC industry report says one-third of surveyed game professionals were laid off during the past 24 months, and more than half of those workers have not found new jobs. The report also found that 40% use generative AI at work.

items.title: Scotland’s game industry highlighted amid new Silent Hill release
items.summary: The BBC examines Scotland’s video game sector, noting the region’s connection to major franchises and recent attention surrounding Silent Hill: Townfall.

items.title: Fortnite temporarily offline for Update 43.10 maintenance
items.summary: Epic Games temporarily took Fortnite servers offline to deploy Update 43.10, affecting matchmaking, logins, and access to the item shop during maintenance.

items.title: Bandai Namco reportedly shuts down Reflector Entertainment
items.summary: Bandai Namco has reportedly closed Reflector Entertainment, the studio behind Unknown 9: Awakening, amid broader gaming-industry restructuring.

items.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved to add Firefight mode
items.summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved is set to receive Firefight, the series’ wave-based cooperative mode, in a free update planned for this winter.

items.title: Ocarina of Time remake becomes Switch 2’s fastest-selling game
items.summary: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake has reportedly become the fastest-selling Nintendo Switch 2 title to date.
